antID.description: The ANT+ ID of the rear derailleur. Set to 0 (default) to auto-detect.

shifters.description: Whether to display the battery status of the left and right shifters.

frontDerailleur.description: Whether to display the battery status of the front derailleur.

rearDerailleur.description: Whether to display the battery status of the rear derailleur.

powerMeter.description: Whether to display the battery status of the power meter.

powerMeterID.description: The ANT+ ID of the power meter. Set to 0 (default) to auto-detect.

teeth.description: Tooth counts for the front chainrings and rear cassette.

front.description: The number of teeth on each front chainring.

rear.description: The number of teeth on each rear cassette cog.
